title: daemon.driveon crashes session-dead on its first reach; work with rhachet to fix
description:
## .what

the route reminder daemon (`daemon.driveon`) crashes on its **first** reach, every time. these
crashes should not happen. please work with ehmpathy/rhachet to fix the cause, since the reach
that fails is rhachet's `clone say` gate.

## .the evidence

one route on uladkasach/dev-env-setup#167 (`.behavior/v2026_10_20.fix-home-claude-settings-lock`)
collected **96 crash logs** over 2026-10-20 → 2026-10-25. all 96 read the same:

| field | value across all 96 |
|---|---|
| reason | `session-dead` |
| ticks | `1` |
| clone | a different session id in each log |

a sample, verbatim except the home path:

```
RouteReminder daemon crash — reason=session-dead
route:  /home/<user>/git/more/_worktrees/dev-env-setup.beav.fix-home-claude-settings-lock/.behavior/v2026_10_20.fix-home-claude-settings-lock
clone:  @:4ae72a7f-5c74-4ae1-aa7c-215d1b863d56
ticks:  1
detail: the daemon could not reach the driver session (clone say reach-state gate), so it
        self-exited on the first failed reach — the U3 no-clog guarantee (no retry, no
        infiniloop). if this was a transient blip rather than a true session-end, route.drive
        re-findserts a fresh daemon on the next live drive while the route stays live.
```

the full set stays in the pr's history at commit `d4ef745` under that route's `.malfunctions/`.

## .why it reads as a defect, not a session end

- `runRouteReminderDaemon` runs its first tick before its first sleep, so `ticks: 1` means the
  reach failed at spawn
- the daemon is spawned by `route.drive` from inside the driver session, so at spawn that session
  is live by construction
- `ticks: 1` in **96 of 96**: not one daemon delivered a single nudge
- ⇒ the first `rhx clone say` from the daemon into its driver session fails as a rule, not as a
  blip. the reach-state gate judges a live session unreachable, or the daemon calls it with an
  address or state the gate does not accept

## .where to look

- bhrain: `domain.operations/route/reminder/runRouteReminderDaemon.js` →
  `stepRouteReminderTick` → the injected `sayToClone` (`rhx clone say`)
- rhachet: the `clone say` reach-state gate, and what makes it refuse a live claude code session

## .acceptance

- a daemon findserted by `route.drive` in a live session reaches it on tick 1, and on each tick after
- a crash log appears only when the session has truly ended
- a clamp that runs a daemon against a live session and fails if tick 1 exits `session-dead`

## .origin
